A modern clinic that's still very well-equipped for animal ultrasounds. The veterinarian is very professional and welcoming.

The team is attentive and caring towards animals and knows how to make them feel comfortable on vaccination day.

An exceptional veterinary clinic!

I highly recommend the Bercy Veterinary Clinic, and especially Dr. Heillaut, who has been taking care of my 11-month-old Belgian Malinois since I adopted her.

My dog ​​is a real daredevil, so she unfortunately needs regular checkups. Dr. Heillaut and his entire team have always been wonderful with her. They demonstrate great professionalism, kindness, and a genuine passion for their work. Even in emergency situations, the doctor has always been available and attentive, which is extremely reassuring as a pet owner.

Today, my dog ​​visits the clinic once or twice a week, and everything goes wonderfully! The staff is always so patient, gentle, and helpful. Each visit takes place under the best possible conditions, with particular attention paid to my dog's well-being. You can tell that the whole team takes the time to care for each animal with gentleness, patience, and dedication.

It's a real relief to be able to entrust your pet to such competent, compassionate, and dedicated professionals. I have complete confidence in them and sincerely thank them for their availability, kindness, and the quality of their care.

A huge thank you to Dr. Heillaut and his entire team for their support from the very beginning!

You can entrust your companions to them with complete peace of mind. I recommend this veterinary clinic 100%!

A very positive experience at the Bercy veterinary clinic. The doctor and the veterinary nurses were very welcoming and caring from the moment we arrived. The team is attentive, gentle with the animals, and takes the time to answer all our questions without ever rushing us. Their explanations are clear, and you can feel their genuine concern for the well-being of our pets. A clinic where you feel completely confident: I highly recommend it!

A huge thank you to the entire team at the Bercy Veterinary Clinic, and especially to Dr. Heillaut! From the moment we arrived, we were greeted with great kindness and care. The staff were very available and attentive, and took the time to answer all my questions. The consultation was very thorough, the diagnosis highly accurate, and the care provided to my cat, Isatys, was perfect. You can feel their genuine passion for their profession and their real commitment to animal welfare. I wholeheartedly recommend this clinic! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
Top-notch vet! 👍👍👍👍👍 …

Dr. Heillaut is a very good professional. She listens attentively and truly seeks tailored solutions for quality care. I have complete confidence in her. My dog ​​Marcus feels very comfortable with her. I highly recommend her!

Excellent veterinary clinic where animals feel at home.
Highly competent.

A huge thank you to the entire team at the Bercy Veterinary Clinic for their warm welcome, responsiveness, and kindness.

We were seen as an emergency case and immediately reassured and taken care of. The whole team was attentive, professional, and truly caring, both with our dog and with us.

Thank you for your kindness and compassion during a particularly stressful time. ❤️🐶

We wholeheartedly recommend this clinic!
Quick appointment scheduling and a reassuring respect for the animal. Excellent care at reasonable prices, unlike all those franchised clinics. Thank you for your excellent care.

My dog ​​is aggressive because he's afraid of vets.

After trying numerous veterinary clinics, Ms. Heillaut is the only one who didn't hesitate for a second to take on my French Bulldog.

Since then, whether it's for checkups, consultations, or emergencies, the entire team has been incredibly patient and kind.

Unlike other clinics where business takes precedence over animal welfare, here you'll find only passionate, professional people who know what they're doing and genuinely love animals.
I wouldn't go anywhere else to care for my dog.

I recommend them without hesitation.
A thousand thanks to the entire team at the Bercy clinic for your invaluable work!
Delphine

We are extremely satisfied with this veterinary clinic! We live quite far away, but we make the trip specifically because we have so much confidence in the team. The veterinarians are always very professional, caring, attentive, and offer excellent advice. They take the time to explain things and answer all our questions.

Our two cats have been patients there for a few months now, and we have always been reassured by the quality of care and follow-up. You can tell they genuinely love animals and are truly dedicated to their well-being.

A huge thank you to the entire team for your kindness, availability, and professionalism. We wholeheartedly recommend this clinic!

Cassis and Lyris 😉😸
An excellent, conscientious, and dedicated veterinarian. The team is great.

A wonderful welcome, and a doctor who takes the time during each consultation to ensure the animal's well-being and, above all, to make an accurate diagnosis.

The team is always incredibly attentive to make our companion feel comfortable.

The best veterinary clinic I know. Thank you!

I highly recommend Dr. Géraldine Heillaut's veterinary clinic. Our Nina is an 8-year-old pug. Pugs are a breed prone to health issues, and Nina is no exception, suffering from arthritis and cruciate ligament problems. Dr. Heillaut did everything she could to arrive at the most accurate diagnosis. She even called us outside of clinic hours to check on us or share results. We couldn't imagine a better veterinarian for our Nina. We also extend our thanks to her assistants.

If you have a cat that can be aggressive during appointments, this is probably not the right practice for you. I have an anxious cat who is vicious during vet visits. I went in for a booster shot. I witnessed the worst vet visit of my cat's life, and of mine too. The vet and her assistant seemed inexperienced with this type of cat. They couldn't control the cat and let him run off and hide in the examination room—a complete circus. They ended up squashing him, probably hurting him, to get him back (I've never heard my cat scream so loudly). When the vaccination was over, the cat was tossed into his carrier with the comment "filthy," a very professional remark. The cat managed to bite through the vet's glove, which earned me (the cat's owner) a dressing-down. To top it all off, I left the clinic but had to return shortly after because my cat's vaccination record hadn't been updated.

In short, our cats are brought into an unfamiliar environment, filled with the smells of other animals, for a medical procedure. It seems normal to me that they might be stressed and scared. I expected a little more understanding and professionalism, especially from a veterinarian with such good reviews. I will probably never return to this veterinary clinic.
A professional veterinarian who is truly dedicated to her work. Furthermore, the entire team is caring, which is very rare these days.
The team is very welcoming and professional. I learned a lot thanks to their guidance. Thank you to the whole team.
Thank you to the whole team and for all your advice 🙏
The team is welcoming and caring. Great importance is placed on the well-being of the animals, who are treated with gentleness and respect. I highly recommend this clinic!

Highly recommend! I called up last minute because of a travel emergency and she fit me in right away in the next 10 minutes. The people at the desk were very friendly and welcoming and so was the vet. She treated my dog with a lot of kindness and has a calm energy and good advice. Best vet I’ve been to.
skills and a warm welcome
Dr. Heillaut is simply amazing; it's not a factory like some other veterinary clinics. She takes excellent care of our animals without trying to overcharge us for unnecessary treatments.

Excellent, my dog ​​was bitten by another, being very close to this veterinary clinic, I went in and was immediately taken care of, the vet and her colleagues were very involved and very attentive to Poker, I thank them fully for their intervention and their involvement.
Competent and kind. Dr. Heillaut Dalibard and his staff are both professional and very attentive. Highly recommended!
A newly established veterinary clinic in the area; very well received and advised.

In Paris, we are currently experiencing the worst heat wave in France’s recorded history. My apartment is not air conditioned nor properly ventilated and can become unbearably hot in this heat despite best efforts. My beloved cat would be dying in this heat were it not for these amazing people.

She’s staying overnight somewhere where it’s air conditioned and she has cold water at the ready. And it’s incredibly affordable. These people have taken good care of both her and myself in the midst of record breaking heat and my panic to keep my cat safe. Genuinely, these vets have saved my cat’s life. I’m beyond grateful for their service and would recommend them to anyone.

I recently contacted this new veterinary clinic for two cats I just adopted following a death in the family. I greatly appreciated the availability, professionalism, and welcoming atmosphere of the veterinarian and her team. I thank them sincerely.

The entire team is exceptional. The veterinary nurses are always gentle, caring, and offer excellent advice. My cat is seen by Dr. Heillaut, and she truly takes the time to listen, ask questions, and find the best solutions. You can tell the team is deeply committed to the well-being of our animals.

I have always been treated with great professionalism and compassion. Whenever I have a question or concern, I know I can contact them and get clear and reassuring answers. The follow-up is remarkable, and the team doesn't hesitate to check in when needed.

My cat is now 14, soon to be 15, and I greatly appreciate that she is always treated with such care and interest. You can tell that each animal truly matters and is never treated like just another file.

This is a clinic where competence, gentleness, and compassion prevail. Thank you to the entire team for your professionalism, attentiveness, and dedication. I trust you completely and recommend this clinic without hesitation.

The staff were incredibly kind, empathetic, gentle, and patient.

Unfortunately, I had to part with my cat after 16 wonderful years, and this painful moment was handled very well. We received excellent support.

We were given the space and time we needed to say our goodbyes and get through this difficult time calmly.

Before that, our cat was treated at this clinic for a year, and the experience was always the same.
Usually, when we took her to another vet, she would come back agitated, extremely stressed, and needed a good week to get back to her normal routine (not to mention the sometimes unreliable diagnoses). Here, she would come back much calmer and less on edge; I wondered what the other vet had done to her...

I simply regret not having discovered this clinic sooner. So, for those who are hesitating: go for it!
Ms. Heillaut is an experienced, well-equipped, and gentle veterinarian. I highly recommend her.

I would like to warmly thank the entire team at the Bercy Veterinary Clinic, and especially Dr. Heillaut, who cares for my animals with remarkable professionalism, kindness, and attention.

Lisa, Penny, Daya, and Ysatis always receive excellent care. Dr. Heillaut takes the time to explain treatments, answer questions, and ensure the well-being of each of my animals.

This is a trustworthy clinic that I recommend without hesitation. Thank you for your availability, your kindness, and your excellent work every day.

Without a doubt, one of the best veterinary clinics I've ever been to! The welcome was professional and warm, and the care I received for my diabetic cat was excellent. Their listening skills, educational approach, and advice were extremely beneficial and helpful. I highly recommend this clinic, its veterinarians, and their assistants.

A top-notch clinic, I highly recommend it!

I couldn't leave without leaving a review. From the moment you arrive, you feel you're in good hands: Sarah is very kind, attentive, and gave me lots of practical and reassuring advice for caring for my cat at home.

The veterinarian, for her part, demonstrates great professionalism: a thorough consultation, clear explanations, nothing is left to chance. You can tell this is a team that truly loves animals and takes the time to do their job properly.

As a result, my cat improved significantly after the consultation. This is no small thing, and it reflects the quality of the diagnosis and follow-up care.

Thank you to the whole team for your kindness and professionalism. I won't hesitate to come back and recommend this clinic to everyone I know!

A disastrous experience... I called to inquire about my cat, whom I wanted to spay but who was pregnant. The purpose of the call was to find out if it was possible to manage the situation, as I didn't want to kill any kittens, but unfortunately, I had no choice given where I live. They told me it was possible, gave me the price, and advised me to come quickly so it could be done as soon as possible. They said they would do an ultrasound the next day before the operation to check the progress, but that everything was fine with them. We drove to the 91 (Essonne department): the cat lives there! So, travel time plus gas... When we arrived, they told us that depending on how far along the pregnancy was, it might not be possible, and that they would still do the ultrasound the next day before the operation to check. I was shocked because I had taken the time to call beforehand precisely to clarify everything and avoid wasting time and money. I told the vet I wasn't going to leave my cat there alone if the operation wasn't possible after all. It already broke my heart to have to put her through this; I wasn't going to leave her there unnecessarily! The vet said she'd do an ultrasound that evening and asked us to wait a bit. An hour later, we were still there with our baby, our cat, waiting. She finally came back to us, and the result was in: the operation was impossible because the pregnancy was too advanced! So there we were, leaving with our cat, who we'd stressed out leaving in her carrier for hours, driving all that way, waiting in the waiting room for nothing, not to mention the cost of gas, as mentioned earlier: with gas prices these days, it's outrageous! Plus the cost of the ultrasound, the consultation, and the deworming: €138!!!! And she dares to tell us that once the pregnancy is over and we've breastfed for two months we can go back to her to have her sterilized? That's a huge joke! How do you expect me to go back to someone who has wasted my time and money?!
A very attentive veterinarian.
